short_blurb: Licensed Class B builder serving West Covina — remodels, ADUs & more.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to West Covina. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout West Covina, including West Covina Hills, Sunset, Cortez, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in West Covina?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the West Covina building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in West Covina?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and West Covina rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my West Covina remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
